title: Image
description: A picture shown to whoever reads: where it is (`src`), what it shows for whoever cannot see it (`alt`), and — when there is something to say under it — its caption. Drawn as a picture standing in a text, the width of what holds it.

alt.description: What the picture shows, said to whoever cannot see it; empty for a picture that only adorns.

caption.description: What is said under the picture, when there is something to say.

width.description: Its width in pixels, when known: the room kept for it before it loads.
